requirement: A booster group has, as a rule, a standby pump equal to the largest pump in the group
quote: …se prevăd, de regulă, cu o pompă de rezervă egală cu cea mai mare pompă…
source_url: Monitorul Oficial al României, Partea I, nr. 1167 bis/6.XII.2022 (PDF supplied by the team); https://legislatie.just.ro/Public/DetaliiDocumentAfis/262281

requirement: Free space around the set for the plumbers, electricians and maintenance staff: front, sides, back and above, as the consultant sets it per project
notes: Luca, 12 Nov 2026: there is no set rule, it is good manner positioning so nobody has to squeeze in to fix something. The figures are the consultant's, per project.
